game.name: Jackbox Party Pack, The
game.desc: The team behind "You Don't Know Jack" presents five guffaw-inducing party games in one pack! You're gonna need more than one party for this. Your phones or tablets are your controllers! For 1-100 players! Games include: - You Don't Know Jack 2015, the trivia comedy sensation with hundreds of all-new questions. (1-4 players) - Fibbage XL, the hilarious bluffing game with over 50% more questions added to the original hit game Fibbage. (2-8 players) - Drawful, the bizarre drawing game—you draw right there on your phone or tablet (very little/no real skill required). (3-8 players) - Word Spud, the racy-as-you-want-to-be fill-in-the-blank word game. (2-8 players) - The wacky-fact-filled Lie Swatter. (1-100 players)
